import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from agentctl.check.audit import install
from agentctl.result import Ok

mode, log, nonce, sentinel = sys.argv[1:]
assert isinstance(install(Path(log), nonce), Ok)
program = "from pathlib import Path; import sys; Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text('executed')"
argv = [sys.executable, "-c", program, sentinel]
native_argv = (
    [subprocess.list2cmdline([argument]) for argument in argv]
    if os.name == "nt"
    else argv
)
if mode == "subprocess":
    subprocess.run(argv, check=True)
elif mode == "exec":
    os.execv(sys.executable, native_argv)
elif mode == "system":
    assert os.system("echo " + nonce) == 0
elif mode == "native":
    if os.name == "nt":
        assert os.spawnv(os.P_WAIT, sys.executable, native_argv) == 0
    else:
        pid = os.posix_spawn(sys.executable, argv, os.environ)
        assert os.waitpid(pid, 0)[1] == 0
elif mode == "veto":
    try:
        subprocess.run(["sudo", *argv[1:]], executable=sys.executable, check=True)
    except PermissionError:
        pass
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("forbidden sentinel executed")
elif mode == "malformed":
    subprocess.run(argv, check=True)
    try:
        sys.audit("os.exec")
    except OSError as error:
        assert "unparseable event" in str(error)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("malformed event accepted")
